ds4-bench
Measure prefill, decode, context growth, and KV-cache size across repeatable context frontiers.

Usage: ds4-bench (--prompt-file FILE | --chat-prompt-file FILE) [options]

Model And Runtime
  -m, --model FILE               GGUF model path. Default: ds4flash.gguf
  --metal | --cuda | --cpu       Select the backend explicitly.
  --backend NAME                 Backend name: metal, cuda, or cpu.
  --gpu-vram N[,N,...]|auto      CUDA VRAM budgets per device, in GiB, or auto-detect free VRAM.
  --gpu-devices N[,N,...]        CUDA device indices used by multi-GPU placement.
  --cuda-tensor-parallel         Enable the paired DeepSeek tensor/expert path on an even multi-GPU CUDA placement.
  -t, --threads N                CPU helper threads for host-side/reference work.
  --power N                      GPU duty-cycle target, 1..100. Default: 100
  --ssd-streaming                Metal/CUDA/ROCm: opt in to SSD-backed model streaming instead of full residency.
  --ssd-streaming-cold           SSD streaming: skip default popularity-based expert-cache preload.
  --ssd-streaming-cache-experts N|NGB
      SSD streaming cache target. N requests dynamic expert slots; NGB also reserves two full prefill layers. Either may be reduced to fit the model, graph, context, and backend working set.
  --ssd-streaming-full-layers N  GLM Metal streaming: keep the first N routed layers fully resident. Default: auto from NGB expert budget; use 0 to disable.
  --ssd-streaming-preload-experts N
      SSD streaming: upfront popularity preload count. DeepSeek auto-seeds by default; GLM demand-fills unless N is explicit.
  --simulate-used-memory NGB     Diagnostic: lock N GiB before model load to simulate a smaller-memory machine.
  --prefill-chunk N              Graph prefill chunk size. Default: CUDA TP 2048; PRO long prompts 8192; others 4096.

Benchmark Input
  --prompt-file FILE             Raw benchmark text; token sequence is sliced at each frontier.
  --chat-prompt-file FILE        Render FILE as one no-thinking chat user message.
  -sys, --system TEXT            System prompt used only with --chat-prompt-file.

Benchmark Sweep
  --ctx-start N                  First measured frontier. Default: 2048
  --ctx-max N                    Last measured frontier. Default: 32768
  --ctx-alloc N                  Allocated context. Default: ctx-max + gen-tokens + 1
  --step-mul F                   Multiplicative step. Default: 1
  --step-incr N                  Linear step when --step-mul is 1. Default: 2048
  --gen-tokens N                 Greedy decode tokens per frontier. 0 for pure prefill. Default: 128
  --teacher-forced-decode        Decode the following prompt tokens instead of each predicted argmax.
  --temp F                       Sample with temperature F (with --top-p/--top-k/--min-p/--seed); EOS ends a run.
  --top-p F, --top-k N, --min-p F
      Sampler settings with --temp. Defaults: 1, 0, 0
  --seed N                       Sampler RNG seed, reset at each frontier. Default: 1
  --token-csv PATH               Per-token timings; per-frontier rows with prefix and logit digests go to PATH.runs.csv (with --jobs: per-job rows and counters to PATH.jobs.csv).
  --jobs FILE                    Resident job runner: save/load/run/quit lines (see ds4_bench.c); needs --token-csv.
  --csv FILE                     Write CSV there instead of stdout.
  --dump-frontier-logits-dir DIR Write one full-logit JSON file per frontier.

More Info
    Runtime full info:         --help runtime
    Distributed inference:     --help distributed
    Benchmark sweep:           --help benchmark

Examples
  csv                            ./ds4-bench --prompt-file long.txt --ctx-max 32768 --csv speed.csv
  prefill only                   ./ds4-bench --prompt-file long.txt --gen-tokens 0
